Split STAC style authoring into style_kit and clarity_styles (#175)

* Split STAC style authoring into style_kit and clarity_styles layers.

Extract family-neutral shells into style_kit, move CLARITY shell compositions out of page packages, and migrate remaining features to clarity_styles so bundle output stays equivalent.

* Preserve print-preview and document-print preview STAC layout.

Keep the original list-tile typography and summary-card padding so the rebuilt feature-style bundle stays equivalent to main.
